Transaction Date: 2026-07-31.

There is no duplicate toll within 10 minutes.

Therefore, the decision should be clear.

However, often these problems have a trick. Let me double check the "within 10 minutes" logic.
Maybe I misread the timestamp of T1519 or T1431?
T1431: 2026-07-28T15:12:09Z
T1519: 2026-07-31T15:39:31Z
Difference: 3 days, 27 minutes. Definitely not within 10 minutes.

Are there any other hold conditions for tolls? No.
The policy says: "A transaction is held when any of these applies... duplicate_toll: a toll charge for the same plate at the same plaza within 10 minutes of an earlier toll charge."

Since no such condition is met, the transaction is cleared.

One final check: Did I miss an earlier toll on the SAME DAY (Day 23) at the SAME PLAZA?
Day 23 tolls:
T1504: NTTA-DNT-01
T1515: TXTAG-SH130-01
T1517: TXTAG-SH130-04
T1519: TXTAG-SH45SE-01

No other toll at TXTAG-SH45SE-01 on Day 23.

Conclusion: Clear.

{"decision": "clear", "reason": "No duplicate toll found within 10 minutes at the same plaza for this plate."}
